title: Plotter
description: Caravaggio's Basket of Fruit as a stipple print from a pen plotter on cream paper: ninety thousand dots, placed by weighted Voronoi relaxation so they follow the tone without clumping, black for shade and a second pen for the warm fruit. Swap the pens, or drop in your own photo, and the gantry re-plots the sheet row by row.
intent: One hand, done properly: blue-noise pen dots whose density is the picture, clean paper where the painting has none, re-drawn under the gantry instead of cross-fading.

sources.name: Adrian Secord, Weighted Voronoi Stippling (NPAR 2002)
sources.took: Re-derived the density-weighted Lloyd relaxation that places the dots; the default sheet is solved once offline and shipped as packed dot positions, your own photo is solved in the browser
